description: A classic whole-body cardiovascular warmup movement warming calves, shoulders, and elevating heart rate.
setup: Stand with feet together and arms resting comfortably along your sides.
steps: Jump lightly into the air, spreading feet out wider than shoulders.
Simultaneously sweep arms overhead in wide circular arcs until hands touch or meet above head.
Jump again to bring feet back together while lowering arms smoothly back to sides.
cues: Land softly on balls of feet with knees springy
Keep rhythmic tempo and steady breathing

mistakes.mistake: Landing with stiff locked knees and heavy flat foot impact
mistakes.fix: Maintain slight bend in knees to absorb force quietly through calves

mistakes.mistake: Incomplete arm range of motion stopping at chest level
mistakes.fix: Raise hands fully above head for complete shoulder elevation warmup

rep_standard: Feet spread beyond shoulder width with hands reaching overhead, returning to feet together at sides
